title: When Do Summaries Become Instructions? Unsupported Policy in LLM Agents' Self-Written Handoff Summaries
abstract: arXiv:2611.06545v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-running LLM agents compact their context, replacing most history with a summary. We ask whether handoff summaries state permissions or requirements the record does not support, whether such sentences change what the next instance (the successor) does, and where they come from. Synthetic tool-use tasks carry a ground-truth permission ledger; same-snapshot replay reruns the successor with those whole sentences replaced by neutral filler. Two AI readers, reading only rule-flagged held-out summaries, confirmed unsupported restrictions in 1.2% and 2.4% of all readable summaries from two open-weight models, and unsupported authorizations in 0.1% and 1.3%. For restrictions, a pre-specified replay test was not significant (p = 0.58); a follow-up, planned after it, found a fragile effect (p = 0.027). Neutralizing false approvals cut unauthorized actions from 24 to 7 of 120 held-out runs (post hoc; later set: 17 to 11 of 48). Most development

translated_title: 摘要何时变成指令？LLM智能体自写交接摘要中缺乏依据的策略声明
translated_abstract: 长时间运行的LLM智能体会压缩其上下文，用一份摘要替换大部分历史记录。我们探究这些交接摘要是否会陈述记录所不支持的权限或要求，这类句子是否会改变下一个实例（后继者）的行为，以及它们从何而来。在带有真实权限账本的合成工具使用任务中，同快照回放方法将后继者重新运行，并用中性填充文本替换这些完整句子。两名AI阅读器仅阅读经规则标记的保留摘要，确认了来自两个开源权重模型的可读摘要中分别有1.2%和2.4%包含缺乏依据的限制性声明，以及0.1%和1.3%包含缺乏依据的授权声明。对于限制性声明，预先指定的回放测试结果不显著（p = 0.58）；其后计划开展的后续测试发现了一个脆弱的效应（p = 0.027）。中和虚假批准将120个保留运行中的未授权操作从24个减少到7个（事后分析；后续集合：48个中从17个减少到11个）。
tldr: 该论文发现LLM智能体在上下文压缩时自写的交接摘要中会偶发出现缺乏记录依据的限制或授权声明，其中虚假的授权会显著增加后继智能体的未授权操作，而虚假限制的影响则脆弱且不确定。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that LLM agents' self-written handoff summaries during context compaction occasionally contain unsupported restrictions and authorizations, with false approvals significantly increasing unauthorized actions by successor agents, while the effect of unsupported restrictions is fragile and uncertain.
